question: What legal_selection_projection and illegal_selection_projection draw when a right click orders a unit: the object, the effect, where, how long, and how it fades.

structs.name: CProjectionType
structs.comment: **A `projectionType` of the interface's .gfx files**: a picture laid flat on the map from above through gfx/FX/project.fx, which grows, pulses, turns and fades by its ten keys. The install's three are selection_projection and the right click's legal_selection_projection and illegal_selection_projection. RTTI: CProjectionType : C3dObjectType : CObjectType, both at 0. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-movement.md, section 13.1.
structs.evidence: The constructor (rva 0x44D670) writes the vftable VA 0x15E1FDC and the defaults; LoadKey (rva 0x44E330) parses the ten keys into +0xB4..+0xD0 and +0x98; vtable.py CProjectionType gives the table, its slots 0/4/6/7 the class's own.

structs.name: CProjectionObject
structs.comment: **One projection on the map**, made by CUnit_ShowOrderProjection and hung on a province's anchor: its own Render (slot 10) draws it through CProjectionType_Draw each frame and takes it off the map once that says it is over. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-movement.md, section 13.
structs.evidence: CUnit_ShowOrderProjection allocates `operator_new(0x148)` and calls the constructor (rva 0x44D490), which writes the vftable VA 0x15E1DCC after C3dVisibleObject's constructor; RTTI gives C3dVisibleObject at 0.

addresses.name: CUnit_ShowOrderProjection
addresses.signature: void __stdcall CUnit_ShowOrderProjection(CUnit* unit, CMapProvince* province, Hoi3CString* typeName)
addresses.comment: **Leaves a right click's mark on a province**: the map graphics from the unit's in-game screen (+0x160, slot 15), the province's graphics entry (graphics +0x1DF0 [province +0xD0]) and its anchor (+0x10), the projection type by name (StringHashFind), `new 0x148` and CProjectionObject::CProjectionObject(this, type, anchor); added to the map's object group (graphics +0x5FC, slot 4), shown (slot 13), hung with ProvinceGraphics_PlacePicture(entry, owner, object, raise 0), then translated (slot 33) by the unit's GetPosition in that province (slot 30) less the template's label point (+0xD4 -> +0x5C/+0x60) - so it lies where the unit would stand there. Its seven callers are all in CUnit::OrderToProvince, each behind the unit's is_selected, with `legal_selection_projection` or `illegal_selection_projection`. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-movement.md, section 13.2.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole (0x5C0C10..0x5C0D42, `ret 0xc`, three stack arguments, the unit in EBX from [ebp+8]); findRefs --callers 0x5C0C10 gives exactly seven, 0x5C1DF2..0x5C278A, all inside OrderToProvince's extent, each preceded by fromCString of one of the two names. functionStart(0x5C0C94) wrongly answers 0x5C0B30 (OnDeselected): the vftable-free entry here is reached only by call, and 0x5C0C10 is its push ebp after padding.

addresses.name: CProjectionObject::CProjectionObject
addresses.signature: CProjectionObject* __stdcall CProjectionObject::CProjectionObject(CProjectionObject* this@stack:4, CObjectType* type@stack:8, void* anchor@stack:12) @EAX
addresses.comment: C3dVisibleObject::C3dVisibleObject(this, type), its own vftable (VA 0x15E1DCC), **+0x138 = the anchor** it hangs on, the byte +0x144 (done) = 0, and **+0x13C (start) and +0x140 (pulse phase) = the platform clock's seconds** (g_PlatformClock slot 5), making g_random_object on first use. Returns `this`. Two callers: CUnit_ShowOrderProjection (VA 0x5C0C94) and VA 0x8408AE (not read; presumably selection_projection's maker). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-movement.md, section 13.2.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole; `ret 0xc`; `this` is the stack argument passed on to 0x4011B0 as C3dVisibleObject's own. findRefs --vftable CProjectionObject finds this one write of the table.

addresses.name: CProjectionObject::Render
addresses.signature: void __thiscall CProjectionObject::Render(CProjectionObject* this, CGraphics* graphics, void* device, float* world, float slot22, int unused1, int unused2)
addresses.comment: Slot 10, what MapObjectGroup_Draw calls; reads only `graphics`. CProjectionType_Draw(&this->done (+0x144), type (+0xF8), anchor (+0x138), the current view's camera (graphics +0x6BC88 -> +0x1C), &position (+0x84), start (+0x13C), &phase (+0x140)); then, where done is set and +0x50 is not, slot 17 (GetScene) handed to VA 0xA76F50 (the scene's queued destruction), slot 14 (Hide) and +0x50 = 1. Slot 11 (rva 0x44D570) has the same body. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-movement.md, section 13.5.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; `ret 0x18` at 0x84D66A, six stack arguments as CAreaCircleObject::Draw's; vtable.py --holding 0x84D5F0: CProjectionObject slot 10 alone.

addresses.name: CProjectionObject::RenderAtIdentity
addresses.signature: void __thiscall CProjectionObject::RenderAtIdentity(CProjectionObject* this, CGraphics* graphics, void* device)
addresses.comment: Slot 11: the same body as slot 10 (CProjectionObject::Render) with two arguments - the draw, then the queued removal once done. The name follows CUnitArrow's slot 11, likely; what calls slot 11 on a projection was not looked for. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-movement.md, section 13.5.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled: identical calls to slot 10's; `ret 8` at 0x84D5EA; vtable.py --holding 0x84D570: CProjectionObject slot 11 alone. The name is likely, by analogy with CUnitArrow::RenderAtIdentity, not read off a caller.

addresses.name: CProjectionType_Draw
addresses.signature: void __stdcall CProjectionType_Draw(bool* done@EAX, CProjectionType* type@stack:4, void* anchor@stack:8, void* camera@stack:12, float* position@stack:16, float start@stack:20, float* phase@stack:24)
addresses.comment: **Draws one projection, and says when it is over.** Time first, the platform clock's seconds `now` (real time): elapsed = (float)(now - start); scale = size; growing while expanding + start > now: scale = (elapsed / expanding) x (size - 0.1) + 0.1 and *phase = now; where duration > 0 and elapsed > duration: fading while fadeout > 0 and fadeout + duration > elapsed, alpha = P x (1 - (elapsed - duration) / fadeout) **with P whether or not the type pulsates**, else *done = 1 and nothing drawn; otherwise alpha = P where scale >= size and pulsating; P = pulseLowest + (1 - pulseLowest) x (sinf((now - *phase) x 3.14 x pulseSpeed) + 1) x 0.5; angle = elapsed x 3.14 x spin. Then, nothing where VA 0x869F10 finds no visible tile holding the anchor's province (+0x144). TextureMatrix = world x LookAtLH(eye (anchor world + position) + 50 up, at 49 up, up (sin a, 0, cos a)) x OrthoLH(scale, scale, 1, 70) x bias ((0.5,0,0,0), (0,-0.5,0,0), (0,0,FLT_MAX,0), (0.5,0.5,FLT_MIN,1)) - the picture a square `scale` a side about the mark, north up. Device: ALPHABLENDENABLE 1, ONE/ONE where additative else SRCALPHA/INVSRCALPHA, ZWRITEENABLE 0, ZENABLE 0. The anchor's slot 95 (ReturnTrue on CProvinceObject, ReturnFalse on CProvinceWaterObject) picks what is drawn: land, world = the tile's (+0x17C) and VA 0x863CA0 draws the province's own triangles of its first tile, so the picture is cut to the province; sea, world = translation(position x, 0, position z) x the anchor's world and a triangle fan of four float2 corners at +-10 through the type's declaration (+0xD4). Sets TextureMatrix, Alpha, WorldViewMatrix, WorldMatrix, ViewMatrix (camera slot 91), ProjectionMatrix (slot 93), tex0, by name. Restores ZENABLE 1, ZWRITEENABLE 1, ALPHABLENDENABLE 0, SRCALPHA/INVSRCALPHA. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-movement.md, sections 13.3 and 13.4.
addresses.evidence: Read on the listing 0x84D9B0..0x84E325 (`ret 0x18` at 0x84DBA5 and 0x84E325; EAX tested `cmp byte [edi],0` at entry and set `mov byte [edi],1` at 0x84DB9C), the x87 stack of the pulse and fade followed instruction by instruction; constants read from the image: 0x171DBAC 1.0, 0x160A3C0 (double)0.1f, 0x160A700 (double)3.14f, 0x160A308 0.5, 0x160A4C8 50.0, 0x160A6F8 49.0, 0x160A6F0 70.0f, 0x160A588 -10.0f, 0x171DBB0 10.0f, 0x15AB304 0.5f, 0x174C56C -0.5f, 0x160A278 FLT_MAX, 0x160A310 FLT_MIN. Push order of D3DXMatrixLookAtLH (pUp orig esp+0x48, pAt +0x54, pEye +0x3C) settles eye 50 and at 49. Would be shown wrong by a running game whose mark does not fade from 1 s to 2 s.

See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-movement.md, section 13.1.

addresses.name: CProjectionType::LoadResources
addresses.comment: Slot 6. The texture (+0x98) through the texture handler (VA 0xA60F30, flag 1) into +0x94; **the effect by FxHandler_Register(graphics +0x6BCFC, path "gfx/FX/project.fx", key "projectioneffect", device) into +0x90 - hardcoded, every projection type sharing it, there being no effectFile key**; CreateVertexDeclaration (device slot 86) of the static elements at VA 0x170ACD0 into +0xD4, a failure being the message box "CreateVertexDeclaration failed!! (WaterVertexDecl, projection)" and FatalExit(1). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-movement.md, section 13.1.

addresses.name: CUnit::OrderToProvince
addresses.signature: void __thiscall CUnit::OrderToProvince(CUnit* this, CMapProvince* province, bool append)
addresses.comment: **CUnit slot 6: a right click on a province with this unit selected.** A unit in a battle is never appended to. Nothing happens for a unit with no brigades, a retreating one, or one with an AI agent on a unit above it. For a land unit outside the battle plan branch: the province it stands in, with `append` clear or no path, posts a CCancelMovementCommand; a province CUnit::CanMoveTo refuses gets the `illegal_selection_projection` mark and the `error` sound; otherwise `legal_selection_projection`, the sound `army_move`, and `CMoveCommand(unit, province id, !append, 0, 0)`. **Every mark is CUnit_ShowOrderProjection's and made only for a unit whose is_selected (+4) is set.** An air unit out of battle and selected opens the orders window (kind 1); otherwise it gets the legal mark and a CMoveCommand with nothing tested, then `air_move`. A fleet where the sea joins (SeaConnected): with a path, its own province, a cancel; append clear, out of battle and selected, the orders window (kind 0); else `navy_move`, and COrder::IsTargetInRange decides a CMoveCommand with the legal mark or the illegal mark alone. Where the sea does not join: the orders window for a coast its first carried unit may stand in (append clear, out of battle), else the illegal mark and `error`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-movement.md, sections 1 and 13.2. **The battle plan branch**, read 2026-11-09: for a land unit of the player's with an agent (a unit under an agent above it has returned already), selected and above a division: a plain click posts CTogglePlanObjectiveCommand(unit, province); an appending click calls slot 29 (CUnit::SetPlanAxisTo), **and where that answers false returns with no sound and no mark**. Either plays `army_move` and leaves the legal mark; a division (oob level 4 and up) in that branch gets the illegal mark and `error`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-frontline.md, section 7.
addresses.revises: The comment only: the fleet and air branches, which it called not read through, are read as far as their marks and sounds; every mark is said to need is_selected; the plan branch's failed axis and its division case are added. Signature, name and confidence unchanged.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole on the mapmarks copy: the seven calls of 0x5C0C10, each under `if (this->is_selected != false)`; the air branch `if (combats.count < 1 && is_selected) OpenOrdersView(1) else { legal; CMoveCommand }`; the fleet branch through SeaConnected, IsTargetInRange and the carried unit's slot 34 (0x88) on CNavy +0x2E4's first node; the plan branch's `if (!SetPlanAxisTo(...)) return` and its `oob_level < 4` else.

struct_fields.name: graphics
struct_fields.comment: The constructor's argument; LoadResources and the draw reach the device and the texture and effect tables through it.
struct_fields.evidence: Constructor `mov [eax+0x8c], esi` from [ebp+8]; the draw reads +0x8C -> +0x64 (device) and -> +0x6BD00 (effects).

struct_fields.name: effect_index
struct_fields.comment: The shared project.fx effect's index in the graphics' effect list (one-based: the draw takes list[+0x90 - 1], none where 0); -1 until LoadResources.
struct_fields.evidence: Constructor -1; LoadResources stores FxHandler_Register's answer; the draw's `mov ebx,[edx+eax*4-4]`.

struct_fields.name: texture_index
struct_fields.comment: The picture's index in the texture handler's table (entries of 0x2C bytes from graphics +0x15C), -1 for none or above 9999 treated as none; -1 until LoadResources.
struct_fields.evidence: Constructor -1; LoadResources stores VA 0xA60F30's answer; the draw's `imul ecx,ecx,0x2c; mov ecx,[ecx+edx+0x15c]` behind the -1 and 0x270F tests; ReleaseResources resets it.

struct_fields.name: texture_file
struct_fields.evidence: LoadKey's textureFile case parses a string into +0x98; LoadResources hands +0x98 to the texture handler.

struct_fields.name: additive
struct_fields.comment: `additative`: blended ONE / ONE where set, SRCALPHA / INVSRCALPHA where not. No by default.
struct_fields.evidence: LoadKey's additative case; the draw's `cmp byte [esi+0xb4],0` choosing SetRenderState(19, 2) and (20, 2) or (19, 5) and (20, 6).

struct_fields.name: pulsating
struct_fields.comment: `pulsating`: the alpha pulses once grown - but the fade pulses whatever it says. No by default.
struct_fields.evidence: LoadKey's pulsating case; the draw's test at 0x84DBC0, absent from the fade branch.

struct_fields.name: expanding
struct_fields.comment: `expanding`: seconds to grow from 0.1 to `size`. 0 by default.
struct_fields.evidence: LoadKey; the draw's comparison and division at 0x84DA24..0x84DA9A.

struct_fields.name: size
struct_fields.comment: `size`: the side, in map units, of the square the picture covers once grown (the ortho projection's width and height). 1.0 by default.
struct_fields.evidence: Constructor from 0x171DBAC (1.0); LoadKey; the draw's scale, handed to D3DXMatrixOrthoLH.

struct_fields.name: pulse_lowest
struct_fields.comment: `pulseLowest`: the alpha the pulse falls to. 0.4 by default.
struct_fields.evidence: Constructor from 0x170AC10 (0.4f); LoadKey; the draw's x87 blend at 0x84DB1D and 0x84DBCD.

struct_fields.name: pulse_speed
struct_fields.comment: `pulseSpeed`: the pulse's sine runs at 3.14 x this radians a second. 3.0 by default.
struct_fields.evidence: Constructor from 0x171DC88 (3.0); LoadKey; the draw's multiplier before FloatSin.

struct_fields.name: spin
struct_fields.comment: `spin`: the picture turns 3.14 x this radians a second. 0 by default.
struct_fields.evidence: LoadKey; the draw's `mulsd` at 0x84DD0F before the sine and cosine of the look's up.

struct_fields.name: duration
struct_fields.comment: `duration`: seconds before it fades; 0 is for good. 0 by default.
struct_fields.evidence: LoadKey; the draw's two comparisons at 0x84DAC1..0x84DAE5.

struct_fields.name: fadeout
struct_fields.comment: `fadeout`: seconds the fade takes after `duration`; 0 is gone at once. 0 by default.
struct_fields.evidence: LoadKey; the draw's test at 0x84DAEB and division at 0x84DB81.

struct_fields.name: vertex_declaration
struct_fields.comment: The IDirect3DVertexDeclaration9 of the sea's square, made by LoadResources from the static elements at VA 0x170ACD0, float2 positions by the stride of 8 (inferred).
struct_fields.evidence: LoadResources' device slot 86 call with &+0xD4; ReleaseResources releases it; the draw's device slot 87 (SetVertexDeclaration) with +0xD4 before DrawPrimitiveUP(.., 8).

struct_fields.name: removal_queued
struct_fields.comment: Set once Render has queued the object's destruction and hidden it, so it is queued once.

struct_fields.name: anchor
struct_fields.comment: The province's anchor it hangs on - a CProvinceObject on land, a CProvinceWaterObject at sea - whose world translation (+0xC4) places it and whose slot 95 picks land's triangles or the sea's square.
struct_fields.evidence: Constructor's third argument stored at +0x138; CUnit_ShowOrderProjection passes the entry's +0x10; Render hands it to the draw as its second argument.

struct_fields.name: start
struct_fields.comment: The platform clock's seconds when it was made.
struct_fields.evidence: Constructor `param_1[0x4f] = clock`; Render passes it by value as the draw's fifth argument.

struct_fields.name: pulse_phase
struct_fields.comment: Where the pulse's sine starts: the clock at making, then the clock of each frame while it grows.
struct_fields.evidence: Constructor `param_1[0x50] = clock`; Render passes &+0x140; the draw's `movss [ebx], xmm2` in the growing branch.

struct_fields.name: done
struct_fields.comment: Set by the draw the frame its clock is past duration + fadeout; Render then queues its removal.
struct_fields.evidence: Constructor zeroes it; Render passes &+0x144 in EAX; the draw's `mov byte [edi], 1` at 0x84DB9C.

slots_noted: CProjectionObject slot 9 (VA 0x84D540) is shared with C3dVisibleObject and one other table, a scalar deleting destructor's folded body, so it is left unnamed here.
